question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one having D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7222b884bf56dd1cc80e253a87ccab59eeb52196b86b8415a15b183f9a8da78c.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'D', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

Now, letter 'D' is given in Dice 2 and Dice 3, 

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/148963a22b9715675b6a85386ec6776941f057998738012ae727d1f58ec0cf74.png] 

→ D is the common surface and B, F, C, A is the adjacent surface.

So, the remaining 'E' will be the opposite face of 'D'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
